resources.string: This app does not connect to the internet. Input and diagnostics stay on this device. Attaching keyboard actions is off by default.
The keyboard processes keystrokes, candidates and predictions on this device. Personal dictionary learning is on by default. You can turn it off or clear your dictionary in Keyboard settings.

If the keyboard crashes, the app keeps one basic report on this device with the time, app and Android versions, thread name, error type and stack trace. If you opt in, the report may include the last %1$d keystrokes and selections in ordinary text fields. Android field flags identify password, number, phone, email, URL and private fields to skip. Similar content typed in an ordinary field may still be recorded. You can review or delete the report in Settings.
The app has no internet permission and does not upload input, dictionaries or reports. You can choose to copy a report or share feedback through your email app.
